newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in thin trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Thursday, with demand staying thin amid weak sentiment, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,420-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,415 rupiah. Crude palm oil was offered at 1,200 rupiah.
"Overall demand was thin, but there was some buying following increases in Malaysia," one trader said.
The MT Pamuradan will also leave on Friday for Semarang with 1,000 tonnes of palm olein.
